Geographies Served Programs TAP Programme District New Delhi Pune State Maharashtra Punjab Uttar Pradesh District New Delhi Pune States Maharashtra Punjab Uttar Pradesh The Apprenticeship Project (TAP) employs an AI and NLP-powered WhatsApp chatbot named TAP Buddy to facilitate the TAP programme, aiming to cultivate 21st-century skills among middle and high school students from marginalized backgrounds in India. Through co-curricular electives and self-directed learning, the chatbot delivers a video-based curriculum, guiding students to complete projects independently. TAP Buddy offers students personalized support, video resources, and motivational assistance. The curriculum is strategically designed to enhance skills like confidence, communication, problem-solving, and self-awareness while also broadening students' horizons and instilling a growth mindset. The courses offered, including coding, visual arts, financial literacy, science, and performing arts, empower students to develop essential life skills in alignment with UNICEF's Comprehensive Life Skills Framework and the National Education Policy 2020. With over 15 million interactions on TAP Buddy, students actively participate in AI-driven, self-learning experiences. Currently, TAP has reached 60,000+ students and 700 teachers across 400 schools, leading to an 81% improvement in problem-solving and a 66% increase in creativity. By leveraging AI-powered assessments, multilingual support, and project-based activities, TAP ensures continuous learning and real-world application. With a vision to empower 1 million students by 2027, TAP is shaping the next generation of confident, future-ready leaders. Vision and Mission TAP's vision is to enable all children to become leaders of today and tomorrow, while its mission is to empower India's under-served children to become leaders by developing 21st-century skills through their AI and ML-driven WhatsApp chatbot, TAP Buddy.
